Reference to the general ledger account to which this tax posting is recorded, aligning with SAP S/4HANA FI chart of accounts.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module; IFRS IAS 12

description: Reference to the customer or passenger party associated with this tax transaction, applicable for output VAT/GST on ancillary services, passenger facility charges, and airport taxes.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; DOT Consumer Protection Regulations

description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tax transactions related to employee benefits, payroll taxes, expatriate tax equalization require employee linkage for compliance reporting, tax certificate generation, and employee tax statement prep
Reference to the vendor or supplier party associated with this tax transaction, applicable for withholding tax on vendor payments and input VAT/GST recoveries.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; IATA BSP

description: Three-letter IATA airport code associated with this tax transaction, applicable for airport taxes, Passenger Facility Charges (PFC), and slot-related levies. Identifies the airport at which the tax obligation arises.
reference: IATA Airport Codes Standard; FAA PFC Regulations (14 CFR Part 158); DOT

description: The timestamp when this tax transaction record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

description: The date of the originating source document (invoice, receipt, or tax certificate) that triggered this tax posting. May differ from posting_date due to processing lag.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IATA BSP Billing Cycle

description: Externally-known accounting document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA FI at the time of tax posting. Used as the primary business reference for audit and reconciliation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IATA ARC Settlement

description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency tax amounts to local currency at the posting date. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables aligned with IATA rate publications.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; IATA Currency Clearance Service

description: The reference number assigned by the tax authority or internal tax filing system when this tax transaction is included in a periodic tax return or remittance filing (e.g., VAT return reference, PFC quarterly report number, WHT certificate number).
reference: FAA PFC Regulations (14 CFR Part 158); DOT; EASA; National Tax Authorities; IATA

description: The fiscal period number (1–16 in SAP, including special periods) within the fiscal year to which this tax transaction is assigned. Supports period-end close and tax accrual reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 34

description: The fiscal year to which this tax transaction is assigned in the airline's financial calendar. Used for annual tax provision, corporate income tax filing, and IFRS financial statement preparation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Module; IFRS IAS 12

description: Indicates whether this input tax amount is recoverable (reclaimable) from the tax authority as a credit against output tax liability. True for recoverable input VAT/GST; False for irrecoverable taxes such as non-deductible VAT on entertainment or blocked input tax.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; IFRS IAS 12

description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company code's local (functional) currency (e.g., USD for a US entity, EUR for a German entity). Used for statutory reporting and local tax filings.
reference: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

description: The tax amount translated into the company code's local (functional) currency using the exchange rate at posting date. Required for statutory financial reporting and local tax authority filings.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

description: The net amount after tax, representing the total transaction value inclusive of tax (taxable_base_amount + tax_amount). Used for financial statement presentation and settlement reconciliation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 12; IATA ARC Settlement

description: The date on which the tax transaction was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the principal business event date for this transaction.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 12; DOT Financial Reporting

description: SAP CO profit center associated with this tax transaction, enabling profitability analysis by route, fleet type, or business unit. Supports RASK (Revenue per Available Seat Kilometer) and segment reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Module; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

description: The date on which the tax amount was remitted (paid) to the relevant tax authority. Null until payment is made. Used to confirm compliance with statutory payment deadlines and avoid late payment penalties.
reference: FAA PFC Regulations; DOT; EASA; National Tax Authorities; IATA BSP

description: The SAP FI document number of the reversal posting if this tax transaction has been reversed or cancelled. Null for active postings. Supports audit trail and reconciliation of corrected tax entries.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 8 Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors

description: SAP FI reversal reason code explaining why this tax posting was reversed (e.g., data entry error, duplicate posting, credit note issued). Null for non-reversed transactions.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 8

description: The reference number of the originating source document (e.g., vendor invoice number, AWB number for cargo customs, PNR for passenger-related taxes, BSP billing reference). Enables traceability from tax posting back to the originating business transaction.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IATA BSP; IATA AWB Standards; Amadeus Altéa PSS

description: Type of the originating business document that generated this tax posting. INVOICE=vendor or customer invoice; CREDIT_NOTE=credit memo; PAYMENT=payment document; JOURNAL=manual journal entry; CUSTOMS_DECL=customs declaration for cargo; PFC_REPORT=Passenger Facility Charge quarterly report; WHT_CERT=withholding tax certificate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INVOICE|CREDIT_NOTE|PAYMENT|JOURNAL|CUSTOMS_DECL|PFC_REPORT|WHT_CERT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IATA BSP; FAA PFC Regulations; DOT

description: The calculated tax amount in the transaction currency. Represents the actual tax liability or recoverable tax for this posting. Core monetary component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IFRS IAS 12; DOT Financial Reporting; IATA BSP

description: Name of the government or regulatory body to which this tax is remitted (e.g., 'IRS', 'HMRC', 'Bundeszentralamt für Steuern', 'FAA - PFC'). Required for tax filing and regulatory reporting.
reference: FAA; EASA; DOT; IATA; ICAO; National Civil Aviation Authorities

description: SAP FI-TX tax code identifying the applicable tax type and rate combination (e.g., V1 for standard VAT, W1 for withholding tax, PF for Passenger Facility Charge). Drives automatic tax calculation and account determination.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IATA; FAA PFC Regulations

description: Indicates whether this is an input tax (recoverable tax paid on purchases/vendor invoices) or output tax (tax collected from customers on sales of ancillary services and tickets). Drives VAT/GST net settlement calculation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IFRS IAS 12; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction (country, state, or municipality) that levies this tax. Supports multi-jurisdiction tax compliance across the airline's global route network. Aligns with SAP FI-TX jurisdiction configuration.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IATA; ICAO; ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

description: Human-readable name of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., 'United States Federal', 'Germany VAT', 'New York State', 'London Heathrow Airport'). Supports tax reporting and audit documentation.
The fiscal tax reporting period in YYYY-MM format to which this tax transaction belongs. Used for VAT/GST return filing, withholding tax remittance, and corporate income tax provision reporting.

The applicable tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 20.0000 for 20% VAT, 7.5000 for 7.5% WHT). Sourced from the tax code configuration in SAP FI-TX and validated against jurisdiction-specific statutory rates.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IATA; FAA; EASA; National Tax Authorities

description: The period identifier for the tax return in which this transaction is reported to the tax authority. May be monthly (YYYY-MM) or quarterly (YYYY-Q1 through YYYY-Q4) depending on jurisdiction requirements.
reference: DOT; FAA; EASA; National Tax Authorities; IATA

description: Classification of the tax category applicable to this transaction. VAT=Value Added Tax, GST=Goods and Services Tax, WHT=Withholding Tax, PFC=Passenger Facility Charge, AIRPORT_TAX=Airport-levied tax, CORP_INCOME_TAX=Corporate Income Tax provision, EXCISE=Fuel/aviation excise duty, CUSTOMS=Import/export customs duty on cargo. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VAT|GST|WHT|PFC|AIRPORT_TAX|CORP_INCOME_TAX|EXCISE|CUSTOMS — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
reference: IATA; FAA PFC Regulations (14 CFR Part 158); DOT; EASA; ICAO

description: The gross monetary amount on which the tax is calculated, expressed in the transaction currency. For VAT/GST this is the net invoice value; for PFC it is the per-passenger charge base; for WHT it is the gross vendor payment.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IFRS IAS 12; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; FAA PFC Regulations

description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the transaction in which the tax amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across the airline's global network.
reference: ISO 4217; IATA; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

description: Current lifecycle status of the tax posting in SAP FI. POSTED=active tax document posted to GL; REVERSED=document reversed/cancelled; CLEARED=tax settled/remitted to authority; PARKED=saved but not yet posted; BLOCKED=held for review.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IFRS IAS 12

description: The timestamp when this tax transaction record was last modified in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks the most recent change for audit and reconciliation purposes.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5

reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; ISO 20022 Payment Standards
